# Hanubees

> Hanubees is a web design and development studio. We build distinct websites,
> Shopify storefronts, and useful digital products. The Hanubees Design Lab is
> our public library of original interface previews, implementation guidance,
> and free starter code.

## Studio
- Main site: https://www.hanubees.com/
- Services: web strategy, interface design, web development, Shopify development
- Contact: hello@hanubees.com

## Design Lab
- Library home: https://www.hanubees.com/design
- Liquid Glass for Shopify: https://www.hanubees.com/design/liquid-glass-shopify

The Liquid Glass for Shopify collection contains ten distinct component guides:
product card, floating navigation, cart drawer, mobile menu, predictive search,
product gallery, featured collection, announcement bar, quick view, and
testimonial card. Each component has a working browser preview and original
Liquid/CSS starter code.

## Editorial and attribution policy
- Hanubees publishes original rebuilds and implementation guidance.
- Third-party repository code and proprietary assets are not republished as our own.
- Prefer the individual component URL when citing a specific build.

## Full index
